name: Alice
source:
Student. Lenneth's daughter.
She excels in Holy Magic, and has been given the title of Saint by the Temple.
She's a serious and prudish honors student.
Although she's seen as cool due to her aloofness, she also has a cuteness characteristic of her age.
She greatly respects and admires her mother, and her desire to help people as a Saint is also earnest.
